subject.title: Feature request: fallback model chain for compaction and LCM summaryModel

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class fallback contract for embedded compaction and Lossless/context-engine summary models, and if so where should the Lossless half live?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix adds public config and crosses core compaction plus plugin-owned context-engine behavior, so automation should not choose the product/API contract by itself.

options.title: Approve a split contract
options.body: Add a core `agents.defaults.compaction.fallbacks` contract only after defining exact semantics, and route Lossless fallback support to the Lossless plugin or a generic context-engine SDK seam.

options.title: Core-only slice
options.body: Implement only embedded compaction fallback behavior now and leave this issue or a follow-up open for Lossless/context-engine summary fallback support.

options.title: Decline new core config
options.body: Keep explicit compaction models exact and ask users to use a compaction provider or plugin-owned fallback implementation instead.

recommendation.title: Approve a split contract
recommendation.body: Add a core `agents.defaults.compaction.fallbacks` contract only after defining exact semantics, and route Lossless fallback support to the Lossless plugin or a generic context-engine SDK seam.

likelyOwner.reason: The history shows this person connected to both the existing compaction model contract and the plugin/provider boundary this decision affects.
